name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
label: Quest
description: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.
Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.
Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
